blurb: Guests are picked up at their stay in Sedona at 7:30 AM and taken on full day tours through scenic areas including Oak Creek Canyon, Flagstaff, and the South Rim of the Grand Canyon. Tours include stops at notable locations such as the National Geographic IMAX theater, Hopi House, Desert View Watchtower, Cameron Trading Post, and views of the Painted Desert and Little Colorado River Gorge. Custom packages and retreats are also available.
